notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Completed 4-week Hosted API trial (self-serve) and ran two internal POCs. Product + infra teams now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency/cost and VPC isolation. Key ask: recommended Dedicated baseline (QPS/concurrency) with burst plan and clear pricing tiers.

Highlights from trial: observed mixed workload (chat-like assistant + search + reranking). Latency target: 95th < 200ms for interactive flows. Cost sensitivity: mid (wants unit-cost reduction vs Hosted for heavy traffic). Preference for open model variants (Falcon-style/Redwood-curated) but willing to accept Redwood-verified models + fallback to smaller variants for cost control.

Observed metrics (sampled during trial):
- Trial duration: 2026-01-06 to 2026-02-02 (4 weeks).
- Avg QPS (sustained): ~6 requests/s.
- Peak QPS (spike during feature launch test): 18 requests/s for ~12 minutes.
- Avg tokens/request: prompt ~120, generated ~300, total ~420 tokens.
- Embedding calls: ~18% of traffic, avg tokens ~512 (input only).
- Typical concurrency (inflight requests): baseline 8-12, peak 36-42 (due to 1) long generations, 2) parallel client fan-out).
- Streaming share: ~55% of generation flows use streaming.

Customer quotes: "Need predictable latency for our in-app assistant — can't have 500ms tail latencies during demos." — Head of Product (Maya Reddy).

Sizing notes / initial recommendation (from SE session 2026-03-05):
- Baseline Dedicated pool: 4 x 80GB GPUs (single pool) to cover sustained ~10-12 QPS with token mix above. This provides headroom for typical concurrency and preserves KV cache across requests.
- Burst policy: autoscale to 8 GPUs for short spikes (up to 20-22 QPS sustained for minutes).
- If using quantized model variants for embeddings and small-chat, can reduce baseline to 2-3 GPUs (cost tradeoff).
- Networking: place Dedicated in customer VPC peered to their AWS account; egress routing and KMS integration required.

Estimated cost/ARR impact: model/infra combo priced by Redwood expected to land in $120k-$300k ARR band depending on committed baseline and burst allowances. Customer prefers 12-month commit for price break.

Open items:
- Need 1-week dedicated soak test on Dedicated pool with production traffic mirror (customer asks for SLA targets).
- Security: finalize SSO/SAML flow and KMS key rotation policy.
- Pricing: confirm overage rates and burst thresholds in proposal.

Next actions (owned):
- SE (Julian) to deliver final sizing sheet with per-GPU QPS estimates and per-token cost model (due 2026-03-14).
- AE (Aisha) to send pricing/term proposal (due 2026-03-18).
- Schedule security deep-dive with Redwood security (tentative 2026-03-22).
